$comment: Differs from the defaults on purpose: k is 6 (default 10) and the size targets are smaller (card 3072 bytes instead of 5120, catalog 8192 instead of 20480).

k is 6 so that the truncation marker '(K of N shown — reason)' appears on real cards; with only 35 short notes, k = 10 would rarely cut a list. The size targets are smaller because these notes are short: a tighter target still leaves room and checks more strictly.
For your own knowledge base, start from the defaults. hubThreshold is left out, so it is automatic: 25% of the nodes that use design_docs, at least 3.
